item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"write\",\"arguments\":{\"path\":\"report.json\",\"content\":\"[\\n  {\\n    \\\"status\\\": \\\"supported\\\",\\n    \\\"value\\\": 30,\\n    \\\"sources\\\": [\\\"S1\\\"],\\n    \\\"unknowns\\\": []\\n  },\\n  {\\n    \\\"status\\\": \\\"unsupported\\\",\\n    \\\"value\\\": false,\\n    \\\"sources\\\": [\\\"D1\\\"],\\n    \\\"unknowns\\\": []\\n  }\\n]\\n\"}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('evidence.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: evidence=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nbefore=copy.deepcopy((requests,evidence,policy))\\nactual=[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]\\nassert actual==report,(actual,report)\\nassert (requests,evidence,policy)==before\\nassert actual==[{'status':'supported','value':30,'sources':['S1'],'unknowns':[]},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['D1'],'unknowns':[]}]\\nprint('report verified')\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}}]}"}
